examples.text: Я ухожу. Ваш сын будет бедным и честным.
examples.trans: I'm leaving. Your son will be poor and honest.

the comparative 'быстрее', often as an order

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: И, Марина Сергеевна, читайте всё внимательно! Особенно мелким шрифтом!
examples.trans: And, Marina Sergeyevna, read everything carefully! Especially in fine print!

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: Я тебе говорю = I'm telling you
много дел = a lot to do

examples.trans: I have a lot to do.

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('other, another, different').

examples.text: Послушайте, а можно в другое место? Здесь плохо пахнет.
examples.trans: Listen, could we go somewhere else? It smells bad in here.

meanings.note: думать о + prepositional = to think about

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that.

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.

examples.text: Костик, ты дурак! Это статусная вещь.
examples.trans: Kostik, you're a fool! This is a status piece.

meanings.note: in threats: ты ещё увидишь = you'll see

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: Core Russian conj meaning 'or' in everyday speech.

испугаться.gloss: to get scared, to be frightened

meanings.en: to get scared, to take fright

examples.trans: What is it, little guy, are you scared?

meanings.note: in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!
All right, here you go. There, look.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to love, to like', paired with 'полюбить'.

examples.trans: I love our town very much.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('small, little').
goes right before the word it negates
accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.text: Меня уже тошнит от этой коммуналки! У нас труба уже неделю течёт.
examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat! Our pipe has been leaking for a week now.

meanings.note: to another job or department: 'перевести в опергруппу'

examples.text: Извини. Дядь Миш, переведи в опергруппу, а?
examples.trans: Sorry. Uncle Misha, move me to the field team, would you?

meanings.note: перестань(те)! = stop it!, oh come on!

examples.text: Да перестаньте! Я двадцать лет в карты не играла.
examples.trans: Oh, stop it! I haven't played cards for twenty years.

examples.text: Иначе я перестану давать тебе деньги!
examples.trans: Otherwise I'll stop giving you money!
Why are we going so slowly?

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!

examples.text: Предлагаю чистосердечное признание. Дадут всего восемь лет.
examples.trans: I suggest a full confession. They'll give you only eight years.

examples.text: В смысле, Виктор Степанович? Прямо так, да?
examples.trans: What do you mean, Viktor Stepanovich? Just like that?

meanings.en: to hide oneself, to be in hiding
meanings.note: Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to hide (oneself)', paired with 'спрятаться'.

examples.trans: Children love hiding in the wardrobe.

examples.text: Да никуда я не пряталась! Я контролировала ситуацию.
examples.trans: I wasn't hiding anywhere! I was controlling the situation.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to scare, frighten', paired with 'испугать'.

examples.text: Первый раз вижу, чтобы людей удочкой пугали.
examples.trans: It's the first time I've seen anyone scare people with a fishing rod.
Watch the movie Wedding on Skype.

examples.text: Макс, зачем ты соврал про нашу будущую свадьбу?
examples.trans: Max, why did you lie about our future wedding?
Then a wedding, and then kids!

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

meanings.note: Borrowed via French 'secret' from Latin 'secretum' (something set apart or hidden).

examples.trans: These are our little men's secrets!

examples.text: А вы кем работаете, если не секрет?
examples.trans: And what do you do, if it is not a secret?

meanings.note: once; что скажешь? = what do you say?

examples.trans: Tell us, when will your programme be out?

meanings.note: the imperative 'слушай' starts a sentence, like 'look, ...'

examples.text: Слушай, Самсон, я тут подумал. Твой начальник — такой опытный специалист.
examples.trans: Listen, Samson, I've been thinking. Your boss is such an experienced specialist.

meanings.note: morning or afternoon shift at school or work

examples.trans: We're on the afternoon shift today.

examples.text: А у нас сегодня вторая смена.
examples.trans: We're on the afternoon shift today.

meanings.note: спасибо за + accusative = thank you for

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

examples.text: Ты слишком сентиментальным стал. А лидер должен быть жёстким.
examples.trans: You've become too sentimental. And a leader has to be tough.

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

examples.text: Теперь я начальник нашей стройки. Ты уволен!
examples.trans: Now I'm the boss of our building site. You're fired!

examples.text: Всё, хорошо, я тебя выпущу! Только собаку не трогай!
examples.trans: All right, fine, I'll let you out! Just don't touch the dog!
Poor cowardly Maxik, got scared of kids.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.note: Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'знать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to recognise; to find out', paired with 'узнавать'.

examples.trans: I'll find out where he is.
You recognised me. Thanks for seeing me.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.
